{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|An enlightened despot, he ''[Uueg Tching]'' is remembered by Atrisians for his skill in diplomacy, in war, and in maintaining order.|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="From the Files of Corellia Antilles">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>}}
[[File:Mohc_Star_Wars_TCG.png|thumb|right|220px|Imperial General Rom Mohc was an Atrisian.]]
The '''Atrisians''' were [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> One Atrisian was [[Rom Mohc]],<ref name="Written">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> who served with the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TDFS1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref> and eventually became a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military forces]],<ref name="CSWE Mohc">{{CSWECite|II|323|Mohc, General Rom}}</ref> where [[Gender/Legends|he]] oversaw the Imperial [[Dark Trooper Project]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
